ambiguities_or_notes: The deleted working title «Рубка леса. Дневник Кавказского Офицера.» is preserved as a deleted English line.
All three kinds of warfare remain distinct: raids; sieges of fortresses/fortified auls; construction of fortresses in enemy territory.
правильнее is retained as more correctly rather than silently replacing fortress with aul.
раззорить, сжечь и истребить is rendered ravaging, burning, and destroying without euphemism.
лазутчики is rendered scouts in the operational sense; no stronger spy terminology is added.
рекогносцировка and рубка леса remain visibly emphasized as technical actions; the singular/plural recurrence is preserved.
The terminal «В 18.....» is retained as an unfinished date rather than completed from chronology.
